svg.title: Website account handover to DorkOS Cloud
svg.desc: Without a valid configured accounts origin the website serves local accounts. When configured, selected browser routes redirect and machine calls proxy to the accounts origin. Managed connections need an independent forwarding switch and service availability; their migration evidence stays separate. This diagram describes code behavior, not the production switch state.
